From Green Day · Price: it only triggers on creatures that move downward.

Theme Affliction

  • 1: 2 actions: release mold in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30-ft emanation} for 1 minute. A creature that moves to a lower position (stepping down, falling, going @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{prone}) takes @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[persistent,poison]].
  • 5: Prone counts as moving down, so the mold triggers when creatures fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{prone}.
  • 9: Surge: the emanation is 60 ft, and persistent damage equals @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[persistent,poison]].
  • 13: Allies are immune to your mold.
  • 17: Creatures in the mold that are already infected are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{slowed 1} while they keep low.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
